pages.parentText: Sam sat on the mat with a book. The sun was warm. Then drip, drip, drip — drops hit the window. Sam touched the glass and cried…
Sam put on his coat and boots. By the door, he saw something bright. He brushed it, put it on his head, and said…
Sam went out. Rain fell on his hat. In the mud, something small and soft sat still. Two eyes looked up. Sam bent down and whispered…
Sam took the little cat in. He dried it and set it on the mat. The cat curled up close. They looked at the book while rain hit the window.
